title: Kissed Crispy Middle Eastern Cheese Knafeh
description: A savory and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring crispy cheese and freshly chopped parsley, perfect for a flexitarian snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces and layer them in a ramekin, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Crumble the akawi cheese and sprinkle it over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley, salt, and sumac over the cheese.
Drizzle the rose water and water over the top of the knafeh, if using.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the filling to form a crust.
Brush the top of the knafeh with melted butter and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the knafeh from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
